svg.title: Conceptual comparison diagram with text examples and image examples mapped through functions into feature space
svg.desc: Inventory: two horizontally separated sections. Each section has a large pale gray circular feature space at the top with red point(s), dashed black arrows rising from two trapezoidal function blocks, vertical arrows rising from lower inputs, and bottom mathematical labels. The left section contains two text input boxes labeled as two instances of x_i, both mapped through f_i to the same red point. The right section contains two image-like Labrador/field input panels labeled as two instances of x_j, both mapped through f_j to two nearby red points. Symmetry basis: each side is organized around paired lower inputs, paired function trapezoids, and upward mapping arrows; the left side converges centrally to one point, while the right side maps to two neighboring points within the circular space.
